description.value: At 7th level, a psychic gains telepathy out to 400 ft. and can communicate with any creature, regardless of intelligence, so long as they have an Intelligence of 1 or higher. The range of her telepathy increases by 10 ft. every psychic level thereafter. Additionally, as long as the psychic has 1 point in her phrenic pool, she can detect other creatures within 30 ft. using telepathy to communicate, although she cannot determine the content of the communication. If the psychic has a form of telepathy, this ability adds to her range.
